properties.name: validata.limits.max-depth
properties.description: Maximum object-graph depth the engine walks in one validation run. Exceeding this is a validation failure, not truncation.

properties.name: validata.limits.max-elements-per-container
properties.description: Maximum entries traversed in a single collection, array, or map before that container is rejected.

properties.name: validata.limits.max-errors
properties.description: Maximum constraint violations collected before the run stops. The request is already rejected when this cap is reached.
